additional_sources.title: Distilling to Hybrid Attention Models via KL-Guided Layer Selection
additional_sources.relevant_claim: generic-text KL marginal-utility selection, held-out recall evaluation, cross-scale and cross-mixer transfer, clustered layouts, spacing ablation, and ranking early stopping

new_overlap_decisions.reason: KL-guided selection ranks layers from held-out DCLM KL and evaluates the selected hybrids on RULER, SWDE, FDA, SQuADv2, and long needle retrieval
GDN-selected layer sets transfer to GLA students and outperform specialized GLA-selected layouts in the reported low-budget setting
GA-S2 is evaluated with Qwen2.5 teachers at 1.5B, 3B, and 7B plus Llama 3.2 3B
complete rankings show teacher-dependent clusters, and distance penalties that force spreading reduce RULER
a preregisterable rolling-Jaccard and K-minus-one backbone rule cuts selection tokens by a reported 58 to 74 percent
the study compares Stage-1 MSE versus Stage-2 KL, addition/removal/average rankings, uniform, activation, perplexity, attention, SMART, and other heuristics across fixed budgets

residual_assessment.distinction: the KL selector still uses a pretrained teacher and trains every one-restoration neighbor; it does not predict arbitrary jointly trained from-scratch layouts without candidate proxy outcomes
lost_distinctions: held-out-task generalization is demonstrated in conversion
cross-mixer transfer is demonstrated in conversion
cross-scale selection evidence exists within a teacher family
non-uniform clustering and forced-spacing interventions are reported
selection ranking and calibrated stopping stability are directly measured
residual_assessment.burden: independent review must show why removing the teacher and all neighbor training yields an architecture-level causal law, not merely a costlier from-scratch analogue of mature conversion selectors
residual_assessment.scientific_value: not established; retirement is favored unless independent review identifies a non-procedural claim with unique predictions and realistic evidence cost

source_limitations: the method selects converted hybrids from pretrained instruction-tuned teachers
every layer's importance requires training a one-restoration neighbor
top-K uses independent marginal utilities rather than recomputing joint interactions
no seed-level placement uncertainty or frozen cross-family prospective test is reported
GDN-to-GLA transfer is asymmetric and does not establish a universal mechanism-invariant ranking
the extended 128K evaluation is single-needle retrieval for one converted model

priority.n1: retirement favored; independent claim review is the only authorized action
priority.baseline_proxy: complete independently because it evaluates the conservative parent rather than either novelty claim

decision.next_action: finish the frozen proxy and obtain independent N1 review; absent a non-procedural claim, retire N1 and search for a different architecture contribution
